title: Image prompt enhancement gets its own path
summary:
Image prompt enhancement got a clearer route through the text API, JSON mode stopped tripping over booleans, and the SDKs became easier to find.

Image prompt-enhancement requests now identify themselves to the text API and bypass its normal per-IP queue. Image safe mode also now rejects mature-content detections without rejecting a request solely because of a separate child-content flag.

Ordinary text requests now have a per-IP queue concurrency of one instead of three, with a longer pause after generation errors. JSON mode accepts boolean `json: true` without a type error, and Sur has switched from Claude to OpenAI.

A new SDK & Libraries section in the README and website showcase points to React and Python integrations. AI-Bloom was added to the project list, and Pollinations Gallery was marked as new.
